capabilities: embed Notion video blocks in notes
retrieve block content via the Notion API using a block ID
configure Notion integration secrets in settings
extras: Docs include a setup prerequisite: the Notion page (or its parent page) must be shared with the integration for block content to be retrievable.
problem: Obsidian cannot display videos hosted in Notion, so content stored there can't be viewed inside notes.

relations.evidence: This plugin can embed your notion video in obsidian through the Notion API

requires.name: Notion account with a page shared to the integration

summary: Fetches video blocks from Notion via the Notion API and embeds them in Obsidian notes using a block ID.
